title: Glass Tea Cups Set of 2, Clear Borosilicate Glass Teacups with Handle for Tealover, Dishwasher & Microwave Safe Large Coffee Mugs for Espresso Cappuccino Latte Juice, 12OZ/360ML
description:
About this item
PREMIUM-QUALITY LEAD-FREE GLASS: The tea cups set is crafted of high quality borosilicate glass to ensure the pure and unaltered taste of your beverage. They are resistant to scratching and maintain their clarity over time. It is microwave safe and refrigerator safe.
EASY TO CLEAN : The glass coffee mugs are quite simple to clean. It doesn't absorb odors or stains, making it an ideal choice for a wide range of beverages. It can be easily washed by hand or in the dishwasher, and they won't retain any residue or flavors from previous drinks.
MULTIPLE FUNCTIONS AND APPLICATIONS : The 12 ounces large glass tea cups can be served in any cafe, restaurant, pub and your own home. The mugs have excellent heat resistance and heat retention, making them safe for hot drinks or ice-cold beverages without any adverse effects. It is great option for cappuccino, lungo, macchiato, latte, espresso, hot chocolate, tea, milkshakes and fruit juices.
EXCEPTIONAL CLARITY AND TRANSPARENCY : The glass coffee mugs also have a unique aesthetic appeal. They are transparent, which allows you to see the color and texture of your coffee or tea. This makes them a great choice for serving specialty drinks or for presentations. The visual appeal of your drink can enhance the overall drinking experience.
ECO-FRIENDLY & RECYCLABILITY: Unlike disposable cups, which contribute to waste and pollution, glass mugs can be reused many times over. They are a sustainable choice that helps reduce the environmental impact of beverage consumption. Glass is also highly sustainable material that can be recycled indefinitely without losing quality.
LOVELY GLASS TEA CUPS GIFT SET: The glass mugs set come in sturdy and environmentally friendly packaging. It is a perfect gift for any casual occasion, Valentine's Day, Thanksgiving, weddings, engagements, anniversaries and birthdays, party and family get togethers. It will be the most safe and beautiful choice for a gift that suits all ages and backgrounds to enjoy an aesthetic and useful classical glass!
100% RISK-FREE GUARANTEE: Expertly created to let you enjoy more delightful drinks, we're confident you'll love our glass teacups set. In case you are not satisfied with our products or the products are damaged during transportation, please contact us directly to ensure that we can provide you with satisfactory service.
